edits.value_json: Aunt Juniper was waiting at the hill foot with a sore knee. “Quiet, please,” she said, while Tomas dreamed of a daring hilltop picnic. Moss hoped nobody would treat him like a cart. Lila tucked a paper crown under her arm and began inventing a kinder sort of celebration.

{"text":"Lila tied the brass bell to Moss’s harness. He gave one careful step, but for Juniper’s quiet celebration, the bell stayed still against his shoulder. Moss looked wonderfully grand.","when":[{"key":"bell.owner","op":"eq","value":"moss","at":"after"},{"key":"juniper.wish","op":"eq","value":"quiet","at":"after"}]}

Juniper smiled, and the hill seemed to hold its breath around their tiny, quiet celebration.","when":[{"key":"moss.procession","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"juniper.wish","op":"eq","value":"quiet","at":"after"}]}

{"text":"Moss led the one-bundle procession to Juniper, bell chiming at his shoulder. He stopped beside her and lifted his nose, waiting. Tomas began clapping first.","when":[{"key":"moss.procession","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"juniper.wish","op":"ne","value":"quiet","at":"after"}]}
At the hilltop, Aunt Juniper laughed beside Lila as the bell’s tiny notes rolled toward the empty plates. Tomas waved from the path below, and the sunny slope glittered with crumbs.
